title: workflow-state.json
description: PO-agent resumable session state — written by workflow-state.sh, read by po-agent and the session-status hook. One file per spec folder at specs/<key>-<slug>/workflow-state.json. The PO-agent (GAP-006 / #32) is the sole writer in production; build-implement-tdd performs a narrow guarded patch on task completion.

repo.description: GitHub repository in owner/name form, e.g. 'macatocz/my-app'.

branch.description: Active feature branch name at session start.

worktree_path.description: Absolute path to the git worktree for this run, or null when working in the main checkout.

issue_number.description: GitHub Issue number this run is driving.

sub_tasks.description: Ordered list of implementation sub-tasks derived from plan.md. PO-agent is the sole writer.

id.description: 1-based task index matching TASK_INDEX in build-implement-tdd.

phase.description: Implementation mode for this task, or null before plan analysis.

agent_result.description: The R1 envelope object returned by the coder agent for this task, or null before dispatch.

current_phase.description: High-level pipeline phase the run is currently in (e.g. 'refine', 'implement', 'verify', 'pr', 'done'). Null before first dispatch.

resume_point.description: Opaque hint for the session-status hook — identifies where to resume (e.g. 'task:3', 'build-verify', 'pr-comments'). Null when not resumable.

budget_consumed_tokens.description: Cumulative token count consumed by this run, updated after each sub-agent dispatch.

budget_limit_tokens.description: Hard token ceiling for this run. When budget_consumed_tokens >= budget_limit_tokens the kill-switch fires HALT-007B.

outer_iteration.description: How many outer-loop iterations have completed. HALT-008 fires when this reaches 3.

halt_audit.description: Immutable append-only log of HALT events. Each entry is written when a HALT code fires.

ts.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with millisecond precision when the HALT fired.

data.description: HALT-code-specific context payload. Shape varies per code — consumers must tolerate unknown keys.

human_review_cycles.description: Count of times the issue was labelled needs-human-review during this run.

github_pr_number.description: GitHub PR number opened by this run, or null before build-create-pr succeeds.

lessons_learned.description: Append-only log of free-text observations collected during the run. Written by the append-lesson subcommand.

ts.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with millisecond precision when the lesson was appended.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the file was first created via the init subcommand.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent write. Automatically updated by write/patch/append-lesson.
